record.question: Which one of the following is not one of the first seven TSA tables for India?
options: Consolidating total tourism consumption, to develop estimates of internal tourism consumption and tourism internal consumption.
Presenting the production account of tourism industries in a form suitable for comparison with tourism consumption.
Bringing together the demand and supply sides of tourism and wherein aggregates like tourism value added and tourism GDP can be evaluated.

Presenting the detailed fixed capital formation of the compiling economy of produced fixed assets specific to tourism acquired by the tourism industries and by producers outside the tourism industries as well as the gross fixed capital formation of the tourism industries in non-tourism specific produced assets.

paper.title: COMPETITIVE EXAMINATIONS FOR RECRUITMENT TO THE POST OF TOURIST OFFICER UNDER TOURISM DEPARTMENT, GOVERNMENT OF MIZORAM, DECEMBER- 2020. TECHNICAL PAPER-I
